title: Voice log
consentBody: Your voice is sent to an AI service to make a draft log. The audio is deleted right after the draft is made. The transcript has phone numbers, emails and card numbers hidden and is deleted after 30 days. Nothing is added to the job or sent to a customer until you approve it.
unsupported: Voice recording is not supported on this device.
saveFailed: Could not save the recording on this device. Free up storage and try again.
saved: Saved on this device. It will be processed when there is signal.
offline: Offline — recordings are kept safely and processed later.
safetyLabel: Safety concern reported by you — not verified. Follow manufacturer instructions and local code.
approve: Approve and add to job notes
approveFailed: Could not add the note. Your draft is still here — try again.
approvalQueued: Approved on this device. It will be added to the job notes when you are online.
approvalConflict: This draft was already handled on another device.
discardNeedsOnline: Connect to the internet to discard a draft.
briefNoSpeech: Reading aloud is not available on this device.
briefSafety: Safety note on this job: {{note}}. This is a team note, not verified instructions.
briefSafetyNoNote: This job is flagged unsafe by a technician. Check the safety note before entering.
briefDiagnosis: Earlier AI diagnosis: {{severity}} severity, {{pct}} percent confidence
draftEstimateCta: Draft an estimate from this log
draftFailed: Could not draft an estimate. You can still build it manually.
draftNotEnough: Not enough detail in this log to draft an estimate.
estimateAiLabel: AI-drafted — check every price before it goes to a customer. Nothing has been sent.
allLinesFromBook: All prices come from your price book.
customerSummaryNote: Not sent. Edit it, then send from the estimate builder.
financingNotConnected: Financing is not connected for this account.
financingMonthly: About {{amount}} per month — an indication, not an offer.
invoiceAssistIntro: Flags to review before you send. Nothing was changed.
invoiceAssistNone: Nothing to flag: logged parts, time and prices line up.
invoiceAssistNoInvoice: No invoice for this job yet.
invoiceAssistFailed: Could not run the invoice check.
flagPartNotBilled: Logged but not on the invoice: {{qty}} × {{part}}
flagLabor: Work time {{work}} min, but {{billed}} min billed
flagPriceBelow: {{item}} is {{billed}} on the invoice; price book says {{book}}
